summary: The amendment closes most first-round findings. Four first-round blockers and three defects in amended lines remain.
blocking_findings: F3 [Blocker] spec.md Face and eye rules: The face centre requires the eye row, but the eye row requires qualified eye components, which require the face area and face width. Define an independent seed and evaluation order. Rationale: The definitions form a cycle, so Red and Green cannot compute the first value.

F4 [Blocker] spec.md The hand rules and AC3: Flipping an unsigned PCA eigenvector toward the body makes its sign independent of the physical palm side. Define an oriented surface or another signed landmark and test a palm-out hand. Rationale: A palm-out hand with the same vertex cloud passes the claimed inward-facing check.

F5 [Blocker] spec.md The hand rules: Each hand-band row requires a body run containing W/2, but a normal gap between the legs can leave that column transparent. Define the leg run for each side and the absent-run and pixel-gap rules. Rationale: A correctly separated hand can fail, and unrelated outer runs can be selected as hands.

F8 [Blocker] spec.md AC4 and plan.md T8: The Mom-only panel removes Kim art, but the standing rule also forbids uploading sprout art to a third party before approval. Require a local route for the Mom panel or stop when none exists. Rationale: A remote judge can disclose the new render despite the standing rule.

F16 [Blocker] plan.md T2 and T4: Red must commit assets/flat-render-pin.ts and scripts/proportion-check.mjs, but the mid-red gate rejects both as non-test files. Move fixtures and implementation to permitted phases and preserve failing behavior tests. Rationale: measure_interphase_checks.py non_test_paths and the mid-red gate reject the planned commits.

F17 [Blocker] spec.md Measurement method and plan.md T4: The script must statically import KIM_CHIN_Y from a file first created in T5, yet T4 must run before that file exists and report the named missing-asset error. Define a deferred import after the missing-asset check. Rationale: Static module resolution fails before the script can produce the required Red result.
nonblocking_findings: F15 [Major] spec.md AC5 and plan.md T7: The new background scan requires a side figure for each reference, but Mom has no side drawing. Define the scan only for Kim's side panel and specify the lit-render row scan. Rationale: The sheet builder cannot apply the stated scan to the empty Mom side cell.

F18 [Nit] spec.md Exclusions and plan.md Scope: The newly approved LATO.2 trial is absent from the track. Record the separate trial in the planned later amendment. Rationale: The orchestrator reports that the trial runs alongside this work under a separate approval.
